## Generate SEO-ready product descriptions with Claude AI in seconds. 

 Describly uses Claude AI to write product descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, and tags directly inside Shopify. Generate 2 variations per product, choose your language and tone, and save to Shopify with one click. Includes Claude Vision to read product images automatically. 

- AI-powered descriptions, meta titles, tags, and SEO content generated in seconds 
- 2 variations per generation with inline editor and full version history 
- Claude Vision reads your product images to write more accurate descriptions
